curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with mirror setup and head checks, staying out of others' blind spots, who counts as a vulnerable road user, and the pedestrian stop rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for your blind spots versus others' and for turning yields versus required full stops.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on blind spots and pedestrians.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach bicyclist rights, the three-foot passing rule and bike lanes, checking for bikes, and looking twice and following farther behind motorcycles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for cyclist rights versus driver duties and for bicycle checks versus motorcycle double looks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on sharing the road with two-wheelers.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover driving around Norfolk light rail and the rules for low-speed vehicles and golf carts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for light rail bans versus duties and for low-speed vehicles versus golf carts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on light rail and low-speed vehicles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain large-vehicle limits, the side, rear and front No-Zones, wide turns and towing trailers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the three No-Zones and for passing returns versus wide turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on large vehicles, No-Zones and trailers.
